  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:

      description: The schema for all error responses.

      properties:

          format: uri

        title:

          example: NoResourceFoundException

        status:

          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600

          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true

          title: Timestamp
